# golang.org/issue/46347: a stale stdlib cgo package should only force a single rebuild

[!cgo] skip


# If we set a unique CGO_CFLAGS, the cached copy of internal/runtime/cgobench
# should be reported as stale.

env CGO_CFLAGS=-DTestScript_cgo_stale=true
stale internal/runtime/cgobench


# If we then build a package that imports internal/runtime/cgobench, it should
# be rebuilt and cached with the new flag, but not installed to GOROOT.
# It has no install target, and thus is never stale.

env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache  # Use a fresh cache to avoid interference between runs.

go build -x .
stderr '[/\\]cgo'$GOEXE'["]? .* -importpath internal/runtime/cgobench'
! stale internal/runtime/cgobench


# After internal/runtime/cgobench has been rebuilt and cached, it should not be rebuilt again.

go build -x .
! stderr '[/\\]cgo'$GOEXE'["]? .* -importpath internal/runtime/cgobench'
! stale internal/runtime/cgobench


-- go.mod --
module bootstrap/m

go 1.17
-- m.go --
package m

import _ "internal/runtime/cgobench"
